title: Eastern philosophy
learning_outcomes: Explain confucian thought in the context of eastern philosophy.
Compare and distinguish daoist thought in the context of eastern philosophy.
Apply buddhist traditions in the context of eastern philosophy.
Evaluate and justify decisions about comparative interpretation in the context of eastern philosophy.

lessons.title: Confucian thought
lessons.outcome: Explain confucian thought in the context of eastern philosophy.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving confucian thought; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to comparative text analysis.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain confucian thought from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of confucian thought; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Daoist thought
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish daoist thought in the context of eastern philosophy.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving daoist thought; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to comparative text analysis.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain daoist thought from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of daoist thought; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Buddhist traditions
lessons.outcome: Apply buddhist traditions in the context of eastern philosophy.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving buddhist traditions; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to comparative text analysis.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain buddhist traditions from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of buddhist traditions; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Comparative interpretation
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about comparative interpretation in the context of eastern philosophy.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving comparative interpretation; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to comparative text analysis.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain comparative interpretation from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of comparative interpretation; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of confucian thought; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of daoist thought; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of buddhist traditions; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of comparative interpretation; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.
assessment.reviewer: Philosopher or scholar of relevant tradition; avoid treating one tradition as universal.

safety.notes: Respect consent, privacy and applicable rules; source and subject review before publication.
